mentions.name: MLSync
mentions.description: This product provides AI-based natural language search over real estate properties from an MLS feed, and includes an AI agent that performs property research, comparisons, and neighborhood and history analysis. It is finalized and in beta testing.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've finalized and have in beta testing an AI-based natural language search of properties from an MLS feed. On top of that, I'm continually tuning an AI agent that is able to do property research, comparisons, neighborhood and history analysis, etc.
mentions.author: samsk
